One continuous take, a single unbroken camera move, no cuts. A whimsical movie stunt scene. @Image1 man: long pale face, heavy dark brows, swept-back hair, enormous waxed handlebar moustache with spiral tips covering his mouth, black turtleneck, charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, glass of gold soda in hand. A thin silver stunt safety cable is clipped to the back of his blazer. Golden-hour light from camera-left.
[0-2 s] He gives the camera a calm knowing look and does a graceful, elegant high-diver leap off the spire, like an Olympic diver, arms out, completely relaxed and happy.
[2-8 s] Dreamy extreme slow motion, high frame rate capture. The camera glides alongside him as he floats gently down past golden mirrored skyscraper windows, his reflection sliding across them; far below, streams of car headlights and taillights move along the avenues like rivers of light. His blazer ripples; the waxed moustache stays perfectly rigid; not a drop leaves the glass; he looks serene, one brow raised, enjoying it.
[8-10 s] He glides past the corner of a glass tower into a warm golden sun flare that fills the entire frame white-gold.
Lighthearted, playful, magical, like a luxury perfume commercial. No text, no other people.
